name: Scoreboard with split-flap flips
summary: Eyebrow, a big word over a rolling record ("DOWN / 4-5"), and a 3-column grid of metric tiles with W/L badges. mode 'enter' rises, slams, flips tiles up, glows swing tiles, then clears (the record can fly into a HUD). mode 'flip' smashes in, flips chosen tiles to a new state while the record rolls and callouts pop, then swaps the word ("DOWN" to "UP").

params.eyebrow: { live (text or null to hide the dot), text, flipped }
params.record: array of states, e.g. [[4,5],[5,4],[6,3]]; one state per flip after the first; multi-digit numbers roll per column
params.tiles: [{ label, mine, opp, win, share (0..1), delta, flip: { mine, opp, delta, share } }] up to 9 (3 columns)
params.callouts: boolean, pop '+delta label' next to the record on each flip (flip mode)
params.flyTo: DOM element (e.g. hud-chip's value) the record flies into on exit (enter mode)
params.layout: { left, eyebrowTop, titleTop, fontSize, gridLeft, gridTop, tileW, tileH, gapX, gapY, calloutLeft }
params.cues: enter: { start, slam, tilesIn, swing (or null), out (everything gone by) }. flip: { in, flips: [times, about 0.7 s apart], swap (or null), exit, end }
params.pace: { enter, exit, stagger, accent } overrides for the PACE timings (seconds)

changelog: v1 2026-09-26: extracted from the DraftKit showreel scoreboard (hook and matchup flip)

v2 2026-09-26: readable pacing. Transitions use PACE (entrances about 0.5 s, exits about 0.4 s, staggers about 0.14 s) with a `pace` override, cues.out means fully gone, and default cues and the demo leave time to read.
